title: DE-4/2022/A2 - Departmental Examination for Junior Members of I.A.S., I.P.S. and I.F.S. - December, 2021 - Division 'B2' (Lower Standard) - Criminal Procedure Code 1973 (Act of 1974) [without books-30, with books-90]
questions: (Part A) 2. State the formalities to be followed by a Magistrate while recording the confession statement.
(Part A) 3. When can a police officer arrest a person without an order from a Magistrate and without a warrant?
(Part B) 4. Explain the procedure for withdrawing prosecution. Discuss the role of Public Prosecutor with reference to withdrawal from prosecution.
(Part B) 5. Explain the circumstances under which a criminal court can issue search warrant. Discuss the procedure to be followed by an officer entrusted with search warrant.
(Part B) 6. What is meant by "taking Cognizance" of an offence by Magistrate? Explain the circumstances under which a magistrate can take cognizance of an offence.
(Part B) 7. What are the powers of High Court and Sessions Court in respect of transfer of cases? What principles are to be followed while exercising these powers?
(Part B) 8. Elucidate the rule that "for every distinct offence there should be a separate charge and each such charge should be tried separately". Explain the exceptions to the above rule.
(Part B) 9(a) Examine the role of judiciary in dealing with environmental issues under S.133 Cr.P.C.
(Part B) 9(b) What are the rights of an accused person in criminal trial?
